name: smarter-drafter
description: Find Smarter Drafter forms, fill them in and get the generated legal documents (DOCX, PDF, EML) for the signed-in user.

interface.longDescription:
Smarter Drafter is a legal document automation platform used by law firms and in-house legal teams. This plugin lets ChatGPT complete Smarter Drafter forms and produce the finished documents for the signed-in user, in plain language.

What you can do:
- Find the forms you are allowed to use
- Read a form's fields, grouped by section, with labels, rules and option lists
- Create and submit a form submission, or save it as a draft and change it later
- Get the generated documents (DOCX, PDF and, where the form has one, EML)

You sign in with your own Smarter Drafter account (OAuth 2.0). ChatGPT only sees the forms and data that your Smarter Drafter role allows.

Account needed: you need an active Smarter Drafter account. The email address you sign in with must belong to an existing Smarter Drafter user. There is no sign-up through this plugin. To set up an account for your firm, book a demo with the sign-up link below.

Region: this plugin works with Smarter Drafter accounts on smarterdrafter.com. It does not work with accounts on smarterdrafter.co.uk.

Limitations:
- Only published forms you are allowed to use are available. Draft and deleted forms are not shown.
- Documents are generated in the background and are usually ready in 5 to 60 seconds. Download links expire after 5 minutes to protect sensitive documents. Fresh links can be requested at any time.
- Files for file-upload fields must be added to a draft submission before it is submitted. Files are taken from a public URL and are limited to 50 MB.
- Answers can only be changed while a submission is a draft. Once it is submitted, its answers are locked and the documents are generated. To change it, create a new submission.
- The plugin does not ask for social security numbers. A field of that kind stays empty, and you fill it in on the draft page in Smarter Drafter.

Sign up: https://smarterdrafter.com/book-a-demo/
Get started: https://knowledge.smarterdrafter.com/
Help: https://knowledge.smarterdrafter.com/help-guides
Contact us: https://smarterdrafter.com/contact-us/ or support@smarterdrafter.com.au
defaultPrompt: Which Smarter Drafter forms can I use?
What do I need to fill in a cost agreement form?
Create a document from a Smarter Drafter form

positive.description: Find the forms the user can use for engagement costs
positive.prompt: Which Smarter Drafter forms can I use to capture the costs for an engagement
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching forms the reviewer account can use, including the Disclosure and Cost Agreement, with each form's name and id. No other firm's forms appear.

positive.description: Read the fields of a form
positive.prompt: What information do I need to fill in the cost agreement form in Smarter Drafter
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the cost agreement form, then lists its sections and fields, and says which fields are required.

positive.description: Start a draft submission. Setup: run cases 3, 4 and 5 in this order in one chat.
positive.prompt: Start a draft of the Disclosure and Cost Agreement, with the scope of providing legal services to negotiate a lease agreement, fixed fee $12,000.00 and responsible partner John Smith and solicitor Susan Davis.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the form and its fields, asks for any missing required answers, shows the answers to check, and saves them as a draft submission.

positive.description: Submit the draft after the user checks the answers. Setup: run right after case 3 in the same chat.
positive.prompt: The information looks accurate, please create the submission
positive.expected_behavior: Submits the draft from case 3, which starts document generation, and gives the submission link.

positive.description: Get the generated documents. Setup: run right after case 4 in the same chat.
positive.prompt: Give me the documents from the Smarter Drafter submission you just created
positive.expected_behavior: Gets the documents of the submission from case 4 and gives the DOCX and PDF as downloadable files with the submission link.

negative.description: General knowledge question. Smarter Drafter has no tool for it, so no Smarter Drafter tool should run; ChatGPT answers it or says the plugin cannot.
negative.prompt: Using the Smarter Drafter plugin, What is the capital of France?

negative.description: General writing task. No form fits it, so no Smarter Drafter tool should run and no submission should be created; ChatGPT writes the email itself or says the plugin cannot.
negative.prompt: Using the Smarter Drafter plugin, Write a short email to a client to confirm our meeting on Friday.

negative.description: Legal question that needs an explanation, not a document. No submission should be created; ChatGPT explains it or says the plugin only fills in forms.
negative.prompt: Using the Smarter Drafter plugin, In simple terms, what is a power of attorney?

publication.release_notes: First release. Sign in with your Smarter Drafter account, find your forms, read their fields, create or update submissions, attach files, and get the generated DOCX, PDF and EML documents.
